outcome: Heart failure in late pregnancy and the postpartum period (HFPP)
cohort: The study included 1,387,457 deliveries registered in the Finnish Medical Birth Register and the Finnish Care Register for Health Care between 1996 and 2021, excluding cases with pre-existing cardiomyopathies or significant cardiac diseases.
finding: The incidence of HFPP in Finland from 1996 to 2021 was low (11.5 per 100,000 deliveries) and strongly associated with several risk factors including preeclampsia, obesity, preterm delivery, twin/multifoetal pregnancy, elective caesarean section, diabetes, significant blood loss, and maternal mental health disorders.
mod_finding: Elective caesarean section was identified as a substantial risk factor for HFPP.
